assumptions.statement: The submission uses the repository provisional boundary and provisional key areas. They are not official redlines and all precision-sensitive layers and metrics must be regenerated after official polygons arrive.
assumptions.impact: Spatial relationships are reviewable as a concept, not statutory or parcel-accurate.

assumptions.statement: FAR, height, density, setbacks, land ownership, heritage, utilities, fire and engineering controls are unavailable.
assumptions.impact: Building massing, demolition, road sections and infrastructure capacity remain unknown or method-level recommendations.

assumptions.statement: Building footprints are conceptual carriers for retain/adapt-first programming, not surveyed existing buildings or approved new construction.
assumptions.impact: Footprint area and density are low-confidence design evidence only.

assumptions.statement: Road and slow-mobility lines express desired connections, not surveyed centerlines, road redlines or engineering alignments.
assumptions.impact: Lengths are concept metrics; road area and road ratio remain unknown.

assumptions.statement: Issue #846 reports that the repository provisional polygon may be shifted from public mapping of the heritage park and named streets.
assumptions.impact: The provisional polygon is drawn as a low-contrast constraint, and no railway or station coordinate claim is made from it.

assumptions.statement: Pause-space services must never infer an individual's disability, attention, emotion or mental state from sensors.
assumptions.impact: Only aggregate space state, explicit opt-in requests and human-reviewed service logs are permitted in proposed pilots.

assumptions.statement: Events, pilots, public-space operations and honor displays require identified operators, permits, maintenance budgets and grievance channels.
assumptions.impact: All schedules and governance structures are reference proposals, not confirmed commitments.

assumptions.statement: Global cases are used only to compare mechanisms such as co-creation, public access and mixed innovation districts.
assumptions.impact: No foreign metric, investment, zoning or governance power is transferred to Beijing.
